title: IDT xGEN EZ Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter all required parameters in the OT App, including Number of Samples, input DNA amount (100 ng in 50 µL Low‑EDTA), Fragmentation Time (minutes), PCR Cycles, Dry Run (Yes/No), Use Modules (Yes/No), Reuse Tips (No), Use protocol‑specific z‑offsets (Yes/No), Include Fragmentation/End‑Repair/A‑Tailing step (Yes/No) and its on/off‑deck location.

substeps.instruction: Input DNA: 100 ng in 50 µL Low‑EDTA
If included, choose on‑deck or off‑deck

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided link and unzip the files if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App Protocol tab, upload the .py protocol script.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place labware on the robot deck according to the supplied deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT App calibration routine for each labware, tip rack, and pipette, following on‑screen prompts.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to execute the protocol.
